sections.title: Author's Note
sections.note: Historical specification succession; no independent runtime requirement.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.note: Transport/confidentiality warning covers both implicit TLS and STARTTLS; SASL confidentiality layers remain unsupported.

sections.title: TLS-Related Security Considerations
sections.note: TLS recommendations and exact cipher/profile matrix remain host obligations; concrete TLS1.2/TLS1.3 fixtures do not prove the complete profile. Client identity checking stays client-side.

sections.title: STARTTLS Command versus Use of Implicit TLS Port
sections.note: Missing implicit-TLS configuration now fails before either bind. Server cleartext availability, client dual-mode support and concurrent port/address recommendations have distinct scopes and levels.

sections.title: Client Handling of Unsolicited Responses Not Suitable for the
sections.note: All three response-filtering rules and PREAUTH cross-reference are client injection defenses, not server parser proofs.

sections.title: COPYUID and APPENDUID Response Codes
sections.note: Destination metadata privacy requires backend readability state; the engine does not infer that state from write access.

sections.title: LIST Command and Other Users' Namespace
sections.note: No other-users namespace is offered; host mailbox authorization remains necessary. NIL namespace output does not prove arbitrary backend ACLs.

sections.title: Use of MD5
sections.note: Content-MD5 is preserved metadata, never a generated/verified cryptographic digest. Absent/multipart forms and string framing have narrow existing wire proofs.

sections.title: Other Security Considerations
sections.note: Reporting, per-IP limiting, cross-account analysis, mandatory weak-account blocking/change request and recommended password strength are distinct. Generic errors and protected configuration have wire proofs; host policy remains unimplemented here.

sections.title: IANA Considerations
sections.note: TCP143/993 service references and reserved UDP port registry actions; deployment does not claim registry administration.

sections.title: Updates to IMAP Capabilities Registry
sections.note: Capability registration process and AUTH=/STARTTLS/LOGINDISABLED reference updates.

sections.title: GSSAPI/SASL Service Name
sections.note: The imap SASL service-name registry; PLAIN does not consume a GSSAPI service identity.

sections.title: LIST Selection Options, LIST Return Options, and LIST Extended
sections.note: RFC5258 registration procedures and OLDNAME registry reference; OLDNAME implementation is not inferred.
